description: Owned the code-ingestion engine for an AI context layer, rebuilding a scattered pipeline into clean, modular packages.
Built OAuth-based repo ingestion across GitHub, GitLab, and Bitbucket, plus an MCP server exposing search and retrieval over HTTP.
Cut ingestion cost by ~50% and retrieval latency by ~60% via token reduction and OpenRouter prompt caching.
Ran SWE-bench evals and a 14-model cost/quality comparison that set the model routing decision.
Building websites and full-stack apps for clients using Next.js, Vue.js and Nestjs.
Desiged dashboards, landing pages, and tools with clean UI/UX.
Scoped and delivered work directly with clients, from first call to shipped product.
Learning Rust, automation, and better frontend architecture and scalability.
Built Meme Duels, a real-time tap-trading web3 game, end to end in React, Tailwind CSS, and TypeScript.
Developed the game backend on Node.js and Express, handling match state and settlement.
Integrated Solana for on-chain transaction handling and Privy for wallet authentication.
Tuned the game logic and betting animations for a fast, low-latency bet experience.
Shipped the product to beta on Solana.
Developed [Router Nitro v2](https://routernitro.com/swap), improving overall cross-chain swap UX.
Designed a modular, reusable architecture to reduce code duplication and speed up new chain integrations.
Built the full [CEX withdrawal](https://x.com/routerprotocol/status/1904176702873633007) flow, attracting 60+ users on day one and enabling direct bridging across 30+ chains.
Managed and optimized the rewards backend with NestJS + PostgreSQL, improving query performance by ~40%.

Co-developed the [Tangled SDK](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@tangled3/react), simplifying multichain integrations with clean APIs for EVM, Solana, Sui, Cosmos, AlephZero, Tron, Router Chain, and Injective.
Created [Product](https://docs.thirdfi.org/product/overview) and [API Docs](https://thirdfi.readme.io/reference/introduction) with sample applications.
Wrote multiple [Getting Started](https://www.blog.thirdfi.org/) guides covering blockchain concepts and API usage.
Delivered Web3 workshops across several Discord communities, including LearnWeb3.
Contributed to the DerpDEX launch on zkSync and Base.
Built comprehensive Protocol, Product, and Getting Started docs for DerpDEX on Gitbook.
Published daily blogs on [Medium](https://medium.com/@0xblocktrain) and [Hashnode](https://blocktrain.hashnode.dev/).
Created educational videos on BlockTrain’s [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/c/Blocktrain).
Hosted blockchain meetups across Indian colleges.
Built demo projects for workshops and teaching sessions.
Organized API HACKS 2 to help beginners get into development.
Focused on learning, building, and API-driven development.
Ran workshops on Tech Phantom's YouTube channel to support participants.
Boosted engagement in PrepBytes’ coding challenges and workshops.
Collaborated with student communities to support learning and development.
Hosted a coding contest with 700+ registrations.
Helped community members improve their coding skills.
